CREATE TABLE objet_source_metadata (
  authority_key_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(authority_key_sha256) = 71 AND substr(authority_key_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(authority_key_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  object_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(object_id) = 71 AND substr(object_id, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(object_id, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  canonical_row_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(canonical_row_sha256) = 71 AND substr(canonical_row_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(canonical_row_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  observation_evidence_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(observation_evidence_sha256) = 71 AND substr(observation_evidence_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(observation_evidence_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  receipt_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(receipt_sha256) = 71 AND substr(receipt_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(receipt_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  manifest_row_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(manifest_row_ordinal) = 'integer' AND manifest_row_ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 100000),
  source_schema_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_schema_id = 'wom-kit/private-objet-source-metadata/v0.1'),
  normalization_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (normalization_profile_id = 'wom-kit/filename-normalization/v0.1'),
  privacy_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (privacy_class IN ('private_archive', 'restricted')),
  alias_derivation_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (alias_derivation_status IN ('valid', 'blocked')),
  alias_derivation_reason_codes_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ((alias_derivation_status = 'valid' AND alias_derivation_reason_codes_json = '[]') OR (alias_derivation_status = 'blocked' AND alias_derivation_reason_codes_json <> '[]')),
  label_candidate_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(label_candidate_count) = 'integer' AND label_candidate_count BETWEEN 0 AND 64),
  UNIQUE (manifest_row_ordinal),
  UNIQUE (observation_evidence_sha256),
  UNIQUE (canonical_row_sha256),
  UNIQUE (authority_key_sha256, object_id, normalization_profile_id)
)

CREATE TABLE objet_name_aliases (
  authority_key_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(authority_key_sha256) = 71 AND substr(authority_key_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(authority_key_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  object_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(object_id) = 71 AND substr(object_id, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(object_id, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  normalization_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (normalization_profile_id = 'wom-kit/filename-normalization/v0.1'),
  alias_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(alias_ordinal) = 'integer' AND alias_ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  alias_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (alias_kind IN ('filename_canonical_caseless', 'filename_separator_folded', 'stem_canonical_caseless', 'stem_separator_folded', 'extension_ascii_lower')),
  alias_search_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(alias_search_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048),
  PRIMARY KEY (authority_key_sha256, alias_ordinal),
  UNIQUE (authority_key_sha256, alias_kind),
  UNIQUE (authority_key_sha256, alias_search_key),
  FOREIGN KEY (authority_key_sha256, object_id, normalization_profile_id) REFERENCES objet_source_metadata(authority_key_sha256, object_id, normalization_profile_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
)

  object_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(object_id) = 71 AND substr(object_id, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(object_id, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  audience TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (audience IN ('private_archive', 'restricted')),
  projection_schema_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (projection_schema_id = 'wom-kit/objet-safe-label-projection/v0.1'),
  projection_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(projection_json) > 0),
  projection_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(projection_sha256) = 71 AND substr(projection_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(projection_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  projection_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (projection_status IN ('selected', 'ambiguous', 'blocked')),
  observation_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(observation_count) = 'integer' AND observation_count BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
  candidate_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(candidate_count) = 'integer' AND candidate_count BETWEEN 0 AND 256),
  PRIMARY KEY (object_id, audience)
)

CREATE TABLE private_objet_index_metadata (
  singleton_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton_id = 1),
  generated_schema_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (generated_schema_id = 'wom-kit/private-objet-generated-index/v0.1'),
  generated_schema_manifest_schema_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (generated_schema_manifest_schema_id = 'wom-kit/private-objet-generated-schema-manifest/v0.1'),
  generated_schema_manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(generated_schema_manifest_sha256) = 71 AND substr(generated_schema_manifest_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(generated_schema_manifest_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  authority_fingerprint_schema_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (authority_fingerprint_schema_id = 'wom-kit/private-objet-authority-fingerprint/v0.1'),
  private_authority_fingerprint_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(private_authority_fingerprint_sha256) = 71 AND substr(private_authority_fingerprint_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(private_authority_fingerprint_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  private_manifest_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (private_manifest_state IN ('absent', 'present_nonempty')),
  private_manifest_sha256 TEXT CHECK (private_manifest_sha256 IS NULL OR (length(private_manifest_sha256) = 71 AND substr(private_manifest_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(private_manifest_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  private_manifest_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(private_manifest_bytes) = 'integer' AND private_manifest_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 268435456),
  private_manifest_rows INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(private_manifest_rows) = 'integer' AND private_manifest_rows BETWEEN 0 AND 100000),
  receipt_inventory_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (receipt_inventory_state IN ('absent', 'present_empty', 'present_nonempty')),
  receipt_inventory_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(receipt_inventory_sha256) = 71 AND substr(receipt_inventory_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(receipt_inventory_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  receipt_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(receipt_count) = 'integer' AND receipt_count BETWEEN 0 AND 100000),
  object_manifest_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (object_manifest_state IN ('not_applicable_zero_private_rows', 'present')),
  object_manifest_sha256 TEXT CHECK (object_manifest_sha256 IS NULL OR (length(object_manifest_sha256) = 71 AND substr(object_manifest_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(object_manifest_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  object_manifest_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(object_manifest_bytes) = 'integer' AND object_manifest_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 536870912),
  object_manifest_rows INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(object_manifest_rows) = 'integer' AND object_manifest_rows BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000),
  source_schema_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_schema_id = 'wom-kit/private-objet-source-metadata/v0.1'),
  source_schema_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_schema_sha256 = 'sha256:c5f2aae02b068bca976ed256e45bea33c8ec44e004df89adc4e15113c09c2150'),
  normalization_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (normalization_profile_id = 'wom-kit/filename-normalization/v0.1'),
  normalization_profile_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (normalization_profile_json = '{"confusable_status":"not_checked","confusables_data_sha256":null,"id":"wom-kit/filename-normalization/v0.1","unicode_version":"17.0.0"}'),
  normalization_profile_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (normalization_profile_sha256 = 'sha256:efd98c04a3adbbabb6907b94f3cb0646be635f2f317d417ce79ba9befb58514c'),
  normalization_helper_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (normalization_helper_sha256 = 'sha256:79081fd211d06705b06fe2123271c135bc6e9c4af2de5dc3331eddd51fb592c2'),
  unicode_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (unicode_version = '17.0.0'),
  unicode_table_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (unicode_table_sha256 = 'sha256:62ad6ed6e49d5d4fe811907822fbff5949a0b86693c36c4196743cfcda06b036'),
  projection_schema_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (projection_schema_id = 'wom-kit/objet-safe-label-projection/v0.1'),
  projection_schema_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (projection_schema_sha256 = 'sha256:baf23a8c453ffd61d32a9d6a7b9cf2024073d91aa821e7712190c28374952d66'),
  receipt_schema_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (receipt_schema_id = 'wom-kit/private-objet-source-metadata-write-receipt/v0.1'),
  receipt_schema_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (receipt_schema_sha256 = 'sha256:d56f48ba45094b9bd7fecebf3739700ecd7e4e02f607d709101e02bcf6dd0149'),
  authority_chain_schema_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (authority_chain_schema_id = 'wom-kit/private-objet-source-metadata-authority-chain/v0.1'),
  authority_chain_schema_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (authority_chain_schema_sha256 = 'sha256:b9704fabf8c718b79f21497cb4c163bb89eecc7ca7620f297a63c402e7155da9'),
  writer_contract_source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (writer_contract_source_sha256 = 'sha256:55f8b4bc23a146640669c231c9a1808de0458c420db95c4e40a9155f36403860'),
  writer_journal_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (writer_journal_state = 'absent'),
  authority_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (authority_state IN ('empty_valid', 'valid')),
  observation_rows_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(observation_rows_sha256) = 71 AND substr(observation_rows_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(observation_rows_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  alias_rows_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(alias_rows_sha256) = 71 AND substr(alias_rows_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(alias_rows_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  projection_rows_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(projection_rows_sha256) = 71 AND substr(projection_rows_sha256, 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr(projection_rows_sha256, 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  observation_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(observation_count) = 'integer' AND observation_count BETWEEN 0 AND 100000),
  alias_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(alias_count) = 'integer' AND alias_count BETWEEN 0 AND 500000),
  distinct_object_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(distinct_object_count) = 'integer' AND distinct_object_count BETWEEN 0 AND 100000),
  projection_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(projection_count) = 'integer' AND projection_count BETWEEN 0 AND 200000),
  blocked_alias_derivation_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(blocked_alias_derivation_count) = 'integer' AND blocked_alias_derivation_count BETWEEN 0 AND observation_count),
  blocked_label_projection_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(blocked_label_projection_count) = 'integer' AND blocked_label_projection_count BETWEEN 0 AND projection_count),
  private_layer_complete INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (private_layer_complete = 1),
  CHECK ((private_manifest_state = 'absent' AND private_manifest_sha256 IS NULL AND private_manifest_bytes = 0 AND private_manifest_rows = 0) OR (private_manifest_state = 'present_nonempty' AND private_manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND private_manifest_bytes > 0 AND private_manifest_rows > 0)),
  CHECK ((receipt_inventory_state IN ('absent', 'present_empty') AND receipt_count = 0) OR (receipt_inventory_state = 'present_nonempty' AND receipt_count > 0)),
  CHECK ((object_manifest_state = 'not_applicable_zero_private_rows' AND object_manifest_sha256 IS NULL AND object_manifest_bytes = 0 AND object_manifest_rows = 0) OR (object_manifest_state = 'present' AND object_manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND object_manifest_bytes > 0 AND object_manifest_rows > 0)),
  CHECK (private_manifest_rows = observation_count),
  CHECK (receipt_count = observation_count),
  CHECK (distinct_object_count <= observation_count),
  CHECK (projection_count = 2 * distinct_object_count),
  CHECK (alias_count BETWEEN observation_count - blocked_alias_derivation_count AND 5 * (observation_count - blocked_alias_derivation_count)),
  CHECK ((authority_state = 'empty_valid' AND observation_count = 0 AND alias_count = 0 AND distinct_object_count = 0 AND projection_count = 0 AND blocked_alias_derivation_count = 0 AND blocked_label_projection_count = 0 AND private_manifest_state = 'absent' AND receipt_inventory_state IN ('absent', 'present_empty') AND object_manifest_state = 'not_applicable_zero_private_rows' AND observation_rows_sha256 = 'sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855' AND alias_rows_sha256 = 'sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855' AND projection_rows_sha256 = 'sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855') OR (authority_state = 'valid' AND observation_count > 0 AND distinct_object_count > 0 AND projection_count > 0 AND private_manifest_state = 'present_nonempty' AND receipt_inventory_state = 'present_nonempty' AND object_manifest_state = 'present'))
)
